# reads

Kubernetes-owned read selections - resource kinds, single-object coordinates, configured namespace observations, Deployment rollout history, cluster nodes and configured custom resources.

`connectors_kubernetes.reads` is one of connectors_kubernetes's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `CustomResourceKind`

`connectors_kubernetes.reads.CustomResourceKind` is a record of three fields:

- `group` — `String`
- `version` — `String`
- `plural` — `String`

Every value satisfies `(group.count >= 3 and group.count <= 253)`, `(version.count >= 1 and version.count <= 63)` and `(plural.count >= 1 and plural.count <= 63)`.

### `NamespaceObservation`

`connectors_kubernetes.reads.NamespaceObservation` is a record of two fields:

- `namespace` — `String`
- `presence` — `connectors_kubernetes.reads.NamespacePresence`

Every value satisfies `(namespace.count >= 1 and namespace.count <= 63)`.

### `NamespacePresence`

`connectors_kubernetes.reads.NamespacePresence` is one of `present` and `absent`.

### `NodeListAdmission`

`connectors_kubernetes.reads.NodeListAdmission` is one of `off` and `full_objects`.

### `ObjectCoordinates`

`connectors_kubernetes.reads.ObjectCoordinates` is a record of three fields:

- `namespace` — `String`
- `kind` — `connectors_kubernetes.reads.ResourceKind`
- `name` — `String`

Every value satisfies `(namespace.count >= 1 and namespace.count <= 63)` and `(name.count >= 1 and name.count <= 253)`.

### `ResourceKind`

`connectors_kubernetes.reads.ResourceKind` is one of `pods`, `services`, `deployments`, `endpointslices`, `replicasets`, `events` and `statefulsets`.

### `RolloutHistorySelection`

`connectors_kubernetes.reads.RolloutHistorySelection` is a record of three fields:

- `namespace` — `String`
- `deployment` — `String`
- `deployment_uid` — `String`

Every value satisfies `(namespace.count >= 1 and namespace.count <= 63)` and `(deployment.count >= 1 and deployment.count <= 253)`.

Five of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_kubernetes.reads.CustomResourceKind`, `connectors_kubernetes.reads.NamespaceObservation`, `connectors_kubernetes.reads.NodeListAdmission`, `connectors_kubernetes.reads.ObjectCoordinates` and `connectors_kubernetes.reads.RolloutHistorySelection`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
